subject: general
question: **Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word**: He made a **fine** distinction between the two theories.

options.text: The police issued him a parking fine.
The fabric was of fine quality.
His fine coat kept him warm.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. "The police issued him a parking fine."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"fine"** in the highlighted sentence means a small or subtle distinction or refinement in reasoning or understanding. (सूक्ष्म या परिष्कृत अंतर)
 
 
• **Example:** He made a fine distinction between art and craft.
 
 
 
• The word **"fine"** in the correct option (Option 1) refers to a monetary penalty imposed as punishment for a legal violation. (जुर्माना)
 
 
• **Example:** He was fined for speeding on the highway.
 
 
 
• Both words are homonyms, as they are spelled and pronounced the same but have different meanings.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2:** "The fabric was of fine quality." (उत्तम गुणवत्ता): Here, "fine" means of very high quality or excellent.
 
 
• **Example:** The restaurant is known for its fine dining experience.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "She delivered a fine performance." (शानदार प्रदर्शन): Here, "fine" means very good, impressive, or excellent.
 
 
• **Example:** The actor received applause for her fine acting skills.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "His fine coat kept him warm." (सुंदर या उच्च गुणवत्ता वाला): In this context, "fine" means elegant or of high quality, describing the coat.
 
 
• **Example:** He wore a fine woolen coat during the winter.
 
 

4c:Td4f,
The correct answer is **Option 4**.
